thread:
maria: CI red on main after the merge — typechecking gate failing (mypy). @sam @riley can one of you take a quick look?
ci-bot: [CI] build/flake: pre-commit/typecheck failed. Log: https://ci.internal.redwood/17823/logs
sam: saw that on my feature branch earlier, weird. mypy error referencing serialize.py assignment.
riley: can you paste the error output?
maria: sure — copy from CI:```
mypy src/redwood --show-traceback
src/redwood/serialize.py:42: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Any", variable has type "Dict[str, str]")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```
sam: hmm, that line does `rv = json.loads(payload)` then assign to a var typed Dict[str,str]. json.loads returns Any -> mypy is right. Did we tighten config?
riley: CI uses mypy 0.991 pinned in pre-commit. Locally I run 0.990 so maybe a behavior change between versions.
maria: CI config shows no pinned mypy version in .pre-commit-config.yaml — it uses latest from the hook image. Could explain why CI and local differ.
sam: easy fix: either tighten the annotation to Dict[str, Any] or add a cast `cast(Dict[str,str], rv)` after validating. Which do you prefer?
riley: cast + runtime check would be safest but quick patch to make mypy happy is to annotate as Dict[str, Any] and add a followup ticket to validate content.
maria: I'll push a tiny fix to this repo: `fix/typing/serialize-mypy` that relaxes the type. Pinging CI after.
ci-bot: Triggered build for branch fix/typing/serialize-mypy (job #17824) — running pre-commit hooks...
ci-bot: pre-commit: running mypy...
ci-bot: pre-commit: mypy failed:
```
src/redwood/serialize.py:42: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Any", variable has type "Dict[str, str]")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```
sam: did you commit the change? maybe pre-commit cached hooks. Try `pre-commit clean` and rerun locally.
maria: pushed commit but forgot to update pre-commit. Running local pre-commit now.
maria: Local pre-commit passes after the annotation change. Re-pushed.
ci-bot: Build queued... running pre-commit/typecheck...
ci-bot: pre-commit: mypy passed. All hooks passed. Running test suite...
ci-bot: pytest: succeeded. Build green ✅
sam: nice, thanks for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
riley: can we pin the mypy version in pre-commit to avoid surprises? I'll open a short PR to pin it to 0.991 and add it to the CI image matrix.
maria: agreed — also filing a followup to add a unit test that exercises the serializer shape so we don't regress.
ci-bot: Note: flake2/format checks unchanged.
maria: closing the incident — main is green. Thanks all.
